Status: design proposal; no production content yet

Species.Form: low paired kidney pods held by clamping pale tendrils
Species.Use: Apply once to stop one BleedingEffect; other ailments remain.
Species.Lore: A hedge-row dressing that rural hands squeeze onto cuts.

Species.Form: three resin-heavy orange lantern pods on a forked stalk
Species.Use: Brew a burning coating through the shipped heat+combustible rule; throw/apply uses actual tonic effects.
Species.Lore: Mundane lamp and fire-working resin, never named as an existing refueling mechanic.

Species.Form: low looped vine with one tall narrow-necked buff gourd
Species.Use: Fill near real clean water, then drink three stored doses; empty harvest has no free water.
Species.Lore: The familiar river-country reusable drinking vessel.

Species.Form: upright rush tuft ending in cream waxy clubs
Species.Use: Equip or drop, light beside an actual fire, then extinguish; finite fuel uses TorchLight.
Species.Lore: A rush dipped by its own wax; a cheap field light, not permanent bio-light.

Species.Form: five red-brown root knuckles showing through a blue-green rosette
Species.Use: Process one harvested clay-coated clod into one existing FireClay; use the real well-lining recipe.
Species.Lore: Roots bind fine local clay; the useful yield includes their attached mineral clod.

Species.Form: flat perforated leaf disks held above a dark bulb
Species.Use: Apply to remove PoisonedEffect; gas-poison and fungal infection are separate ailments.
Species.Lore: Peat-cutters keep the bitter filtering leaves on dry shelves.

Species.Form: drooping blue inflated bells on bent stems
Species.Use: Throw to create actual sleep vapor; breathing targets may sleep and damage wakes them; allies are affected too.
Species.Lore: A bog bell that exhales when its ripe skin splits.

Species.Form: low silver fern with hooked cyan new fronds
Species.Use: Brew the frost rule; its resulting coating can be thrown to apply Frozen.
Species.Lore: Cold peat-fed sap; no promise of refrigeration or heat immunity.

Species.Form: ribbon sedge with translucent droplets on flattened tips
Species.Use: Brew the slick rule for a Wet coating; this is actual Wet status, not an unimplemented trip trap.
Species.Lore: Glossy gel from leaves adapted to waterlogged soil.

Species.Form: cupped amber fungal shields held on short black stems
Species.Use: Equip in Hand or drop to cast amber light; stowed light is occluded.
Species.Lore: A modest cultivated bog fungus, not a manufactured lantern.

Species.Form: low ribbed succulent with one swollen pale aqua fruit
Species.Use: One saved drink in the ripe fruit; fill its surviving shell with two drinks at clean water.
Species.Lore: A modest water reservoir at sheltered well margins, never an infinite water source.

Species.Form: low grey angular leaves with stacked ochre wax beans
Species.Use: Apply temporary one-point Stoneskin reduction for six turns. Existing stacking is bounded by duration, not permanent stats.
Species.Lore: A mineral-rich wax grown in narrow irrigated shade beds.

Species.Form: broad accordion leaf on a stubby bent central rib
Species.Use: Equip on Head to satisfy the actual Beating sun-cover gate; zero armor advertised.
Species.Lore: The dry leaf opens into a head-sized sun hood.

Species.Form: blackened-looking crescent pods with red seams
Species.Use: Throw the oil pod as the existing tonic splash to apply Burning; self-Apply also burns and must be plainly warned.
Species.Lore: Heat-concentrating oil from an exposed wasteland legume.

Species.Form: compact radial grass with long ivory spear-shaped awns
Species.Use: Throw via real penetration/AV damage; recover the spine where it lands. No invented poison property.
Species.Lore: Caravan children gather the rigid awns from protected rows.

Species.Form: pale forked fruiting horns threaded with violet luminous tips
Species.Use: Equip or drop as a quiet violet light; no song/confidence effect is invented.
Species.Lore: Grown, never manufactured; a small cultivated extension of the living substrate.

Species.Form: pale braided cushions with green seams and no red fruit
Species.Use: Apply a moss pad to heal 2d4 once.
Species.Lore: An explicitly non-red wound dressing so the existing grove red-food warning remains true.

Species.Form: tiered lime frills around a narrow pale stalk
Species.Use: Brew an acid tonic for the actual Acidic splash path; drinking is harmful.
Species.Lore: A frilled substrate fruit whose sap loosens what the grove wants to take apart.

Species.Form: three violet balloon pods joined by a pale grown cage
Species.Use: Throw for a real confusion cloud: DV/Agility penalties and confused movement, with friendly fire.
Species.Lore: The ripe bladder exhales a disorienting vapor; no new mind-control or lore truth.

Species.Form: rectangular curling plates grown around a thick short stalk
Species.Use: Process one shed bark slat into one existing SalvagedTimber for the native gate-brace repair.
Species.Lore: Naturally grown structural plates; preparation makes a usable brace, not a Choir sawmill.

Species.Form: sparse paired grey leaves with one conspicuous missing pair
Species.Use: Apply to remove ordinary ConfusedEffect; never removes Thinning, Urqu or narrative memory loss.
Species.Lore: New sparse margin growth; its ordinary sharp scent is an aid to concentration.

Species.Form: very low pale rosette with thin magenta-edged curled leaves
Species.Use: Apply to stop one ordinary bleeding instance.
Species.Lore: Pioneer leaves that cling to the edge of intact soil, not recovered undertext.

Species.Form: one white looped root above ground under sparse teal shoots
Species.Use: Brew through the shipped ward rule for Stoneskin. This is ordinary damage reduction, not a cosmic name-anchor.
Species.Lore: A stubborn new root; player-facing prose avoids claiming to heal the scraped region.

Species.Form: thin grey bulb with a folded spout and two nearly colorless leaves
Species.Use: Fill from a finite liquid pool and pour through actual conserved volume commands; this vessel does not drink or purify.
Species.Lore: A naturally hollow pioneer growth; remains a mundane shell after harvest.

Species.Form: three open hanging grey capsules with yellow inner membranes
Species.Use: Throw to release real stun vapor. No sound attraction or enemy luring system is claimed.
Species.Lore: Air-filled surface capsules; never a singular bleed curio or erased historical object.

Species.Form: small five-leaf rosette holding an open stone-pink cup
Species.Use: Harvest an empty four-drink cup, fill at true fresh water, then drink stored doses.
Species.Lore: A foothill rain-cup relative in actual soil pockets, not on the sacred bare circle.

Species.Form: tall jointed reeds with square cyan crystalline-looking tips
Species.Use: Brew the shock rule; the resulting tonic applies Electrified through native splash/use.
Species.Lore: Conductive sap, not a new mined mineral or industrial wire.

Species.Form: radial red spoon leaves bearing pale adhesive beads
Species.Use: Throw as a corrosive tonic splash; self-Apply is harmful and examination must say so.
Species.Lore: A deliberately original cultivated sundew form rooted in the canon slope ecology.

Species.Form: three white club flowers rising from deep-blue narrow leaves
Species.Use: Equip or drop to give cool light; no light in a closed pack.
Species.Lore: Cultivated luminous associations in moist fissure soil.

Species.Form: paired hooked rose-grey fronds over a dense basal curl
Species.Use: Equip as handwear for actual one AV; no climb speed, traction or new climbing mechanic is claimed.
Species.Lore: Tough folded fronds protect the hands used on sharp stone.

Species.Form: low blue fan-gills crossed by two bright white veins
Species.Use: Equip or drop as a four-cell blue lamp.
Species.Lore: Catacomb cultivation serves the established bio-light economy; no new theology assertion.

Species.Form: five squat tan caps with knuckle-like raised plates
Species.Use: Apply two-point Stoneskin reduction for four turns; no permanent AV gain.
Species.Lore: The stiff wax is harvested from a cultivated mat, not a petrified god fragment.

Species.Form: charcoal root bulb crowned by short pale hooked stems
Species.Use: Apply to remove BurningEffect; the environment can ignite the user again.
Species.Lore: A cool root dressing used near cramped underground hearths.

Species.Form: single pale puffball partly wrapped by blue slit leaves
Species.Use: Throw for actual cryo gas, cold damage and Frozen; affects damageable matter and friends, not a harmless smoke screen.
Species.Lore: Cold moisture condensed into a cultivated underground puffball.

Species.Form: tiny white buttons with black central pores on a low pink mat
Species.Use: Apply to cure actual fungal infection and restore its stat shift; no blanket disease cure or lasting immunity.
Species.Lore: Salt-rich cultivated buttons prized by keepers of clean catacomb beds.
